cohorts.role: Independent repository relative to the known lru-cache development control. Previously observed task; this fresh batch is not a new holdout and is not pooled with the stopped run.

timing.power: macOS temporary caffeinate -i -s -w runner-pid; idle-sleep assertion verified before calls, released in finally. AC-only system-sleep assertion; forced sleep cannot be prevented.

environment.nativeGuard: Native session pins matrix-listed user configuration/Skills, both evaluated Skills, bench and compiled runner before/after each invocation. Inherited configuration is not isolated.
environment.rtkCheck: Additional referenced instruction checked before and after the whole batch; native matrix configurations checked around each call.

calibration.reason: No new calibration; same pinned task, grader and both Skill resources. Timing repair is tested offline before declaring four calls.

analysis: Analyze all declared surviving pairs in this new batch separately. Enumerate improved/regressed public checks and pass/fail. Report paired and all-invocation input/cache/uncached/output/monotonic elapsed, coverage, increases and per-success costs including graded failures. Retain errors and refusal receipts. Never pool old wall durations with new monotonic durations or claim billing/active compute.
stopping: Any execution error, timing anomaly or input/configuration drift stops further calls. No retries, replacement samples, candidate edits or trial additions. Functional failures remain data. Preserve this batch even if incomplete. Power assertions are verified at startup; utility liveness is recorded at finish, not independently attested before every call. A small saturated two-pair task cannot support efficacy, equivalence, non-inferiority or an installation recommendation.
reproducibility: Frozen compiled runner/source, complete Skill/bench inputs, declaration, native receipts/call ledger/public transcripts, timing diagnostics, power assertion record, all deliveries and archive file hashes. Fresh extraction must regrade and reproduce cost analysis; fresh live runs reproduce procedure, not identical stochastic outputs.
